A.claim: The weighted equation X^10 + 256 Y^10 = Z^17 has no primitive nontrivial integer solutions, established by determining the full set of rational points on the genus-8 anti-invariant quotient curve C^-/k via Chabauty-Coleman.

B.claim: At p=3: if 3 divides none of A,B,C and 3 divides both x and y, then C^z = 2 or 7 mod 9, and consequently 3 does not divide z. Elementary (the cubes among units mod 9 are exactly {1,8}), independent of FLT3.
